origin.details: TRUE and FALSE follow the option. An unset option leaves the decision to the caller.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
old <- options(readr.show_col_types = TRUE)
on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
first <- yn(should_show_types())
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)
paste(first, yn(should_show_types()))

translation.details: TRUE and FALSE follow the option. An unset option leaves the decision to the caller.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
from withr._options import options as set_options
set_options(**{"readr.show_col_types": True})
first = yn(should_show_types())
set_options(**{"readr.show_col_types": False})
try:
    return first + " " + yn(should_show_types())
finally:
    set_options(**{"readr.show_col_types": False})
